description: This file defines the EmployeeSkillAPI class, which implements CRUD API endpoints for managing employee skill records within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving, listing, creating, updating, and deleting employee skills, along with associated validation rules and Swagger/OpenAPI annotations for documentation.

classes.name: EmployeeSkillAPI
classes.description: API controller class for managing employee skills, providing endpoints for CRUD operations, with validation and documentation annotations.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific employee skill by employee number and skill ID, throws RecordNotFoundException if not found.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all skills for a specific employee, supporting sorting and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new employee skill record based on provided data.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing employee skill record.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes one or more employee skill records based on provided IDs.

methods.name: saveEmployeeSkill
methods.description: Shared logic for creating or updating an EmployeeSkill entity from request parameters.
